quests.text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

quests.name: Better Late Than Never
quests.text: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

quests.name: Better Late Than Never
quests.text: Check with the Royal Factors of Stormwind to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone. There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.

quests.name: Better Late Than Never
quests.text: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

quests.name: Good Luck Charm
quests.text: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

quests.name: Clear the Way
quests.text: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.  Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Dispelling Evil
quests.text: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Inert Scourgestones
quests.text: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.

quests.name: Forging the Mightstone
quests.text: Bring the voodoo feathers to Ashlam Valorfist.
notes: On Forever, the Signet, Blade and Orb reward choices were removed.

quests.name: Scarlet Diversions
quests.text: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.  Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

objectives.text: Destroy the command tent and plant the Scourge banner in the camp

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
quests.text: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
quests.text: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.text: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Felstone Field Cauldron
notes: Arcane Quickener expires 30 minutes after you get it.

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
quests.text: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.text: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Two Halves Become One
quests.text: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.  Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
quests.text: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: A Plague Upon Thee
quests.text: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: A Plague Upon Thee
quests.text: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.

quests.name: A Plague Upon Thee
quests.text: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: A Plague Upon Thee
quests.text: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
quests.text: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.text: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
notes: The bottle comes from the Scourge Cauldron when you accept the quest. You don't loot it from anything.

quests.name: Dalson's Tears Cauldron
notes: The Arcane Quickener disappears 30 minutes after you get it, so farm the other items first and buy it last.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
quests.text: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.text: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Writhing Haunt Cauldron
notes: The Arcane Quickener vanishes after 30 minutes, so gather the other reagents before buying it.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
quests.text: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
notes: The empty bottle comes from the earlier cauldron quest. You must carry it or the cauldron turn-in won't work.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.text: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
quests.text: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.text: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
notes: You get the bottle from the previous quest 5223, and you have to keep it in your bags to hand it in.

quests.name: Scholomance
quests.text: Speak with Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Scholomance
quests.text: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: A Cousin Abroad
quests.text: Find the missing cousin somewhere on Mount Hyjal.

quests.name: All Along the Watchtowers
quests.text: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.  Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: All Along the Watchtowers
quests.text: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.  Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
quests.text: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

quests.name: Unfinished Business
quests.text: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
quests.text: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
quests.text: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

quests.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
quests.text: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
notes: The branch is needed for the turn-in and comes from accepting the quest. Don't destroy it.

quests.name: A Matter of Time
quests.text: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.  Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Counting Out Time
quests.text: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Counting Out Time
quests.text: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Unfinished Business
quests.text: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Skeletal Fragments
quests.text: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Mold Rhymes With...
quests.text: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Skeletal Fragments

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.text: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Gahrron's Withering Cauldron
notes: The Arcane Quickener disappears after 30 minutes, so buy it right before you go to the cauldron.

quests.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
quests.text: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.text: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
notes: The filled bottle comes from the previous cauldron step (quest 5226), when you use the bottle at the cauldron.

quests.name: Unfinished Business
quests.text: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

objectives.text: Overlook Hearthglen from a high vantage point

quests.name: Meadowrun the Elder
notes: This quest only exists during the Lunar Festival world event.

quests.name: Alas, Andorhal
quests.text: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Alas, Andorhal
quests.text: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Last Barov
quests.text: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.  Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

quests.name: The Last Barov
quests.text: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.  Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.

quests.name: Find Myranda
quests.text: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

quests.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
quests.text: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.  Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.

quests.name: In Dreams
quests.text: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.

quests.name: Mantles of the Dawn
quests.text: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Mantles of the Dawn
quests.text: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
quests.text: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
quests.text: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
notes: You need Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn to take this quest.
Valor tokens are not dropped by mobs. They come only as rewards from other Argent Dawn quests.

quests.name: Araj's Scarab
quests.text: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Araj's Scarab
quests.text: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Flint Shadowmore
quests.text: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

quests.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
quests.text: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

quests.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
quests.text: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

quests.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
quests.text: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':  1 Chromatic Carapace.  10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.  10 Blood of Heroes.  10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.
notes: Forever has removed the Carapace objective and the breastplate reward.
The stitchings and scales come from elite dungeon mobs, so you need a group or raid.

quests.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
quests.text: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':  1 Chromatic Carapace.  10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.  10 Blood of Heroes.  5 Skin of Shadow.

quests.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.text: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.text: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

quests.name: Soulbound Keepsake
quests.text: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.
